issues.legal_issue: The residual category of “other co-sharers” in the statutory pre-emption hierarchy excludes co-sharers who fall within the preceding family-priority categories.
material_facts: The land was jointly owned and was sold by some, but not all, of the co-sharers; the Court assumed it was joint property for purposes of its decision.
The claimants, who were the vendors’ sons and nephews, sought pre-emption and argued that they qualified as non-alienating co-sharers in the residual category.
Their claims under the preceding categories had been rendered unavailable by the decision in Atam Prakash v. State of Haryana and Others.
issues.conclusion: The claimants could not claim pre-emption under the residual category because they fell within the preceding family-priority categories. The special leave petition was dismissed.
issues.legal_principle: Under Section 15(1)(b) of the Punjab Pre-emption Act, 1913, the phrase “other co-sharers” in the Fourthly category refers to co-sharers who do not fall within the First, Secondly or Thirdly categories. The Court read the categories in their statutory sequence as they stood before Atam Prakash v. State of Haryana and Others, which declared the First, Secondly and Thirdly categories of Section 15(1)(b), among other provisions, unconstitutional.

rule.if: preemption_claim_proceeding and partial_share_sale_from_joint_property and claimant_falls_within_preceding_family_categories and claimant_claims_as_other_coparcener

predicates.preemption_claim_proceeding: A claimant sought a right to pre-empt a sale of property.
predicates.partial_share_sale_from_joint_property: Some, but not all, co-sharers sold a share of jointly owned property.
predicates.claimant_falls_within_preceding_family_c: The claimant was related to the vendor in a way covered by one of the preceding family-priority categories.
predicates.claimant_claims_as_other_coparcener: The claimant relied on being an other co-sharer to claim pre-emption.

issues.definition: When a claimant seeks pre-emption of a partial sale of joint property as an other co-sharer, but falls within a preceding family-priority category, the claimant is not entitled under the residual co-sharer category.
